main_text.l: EPIST. LXXXVII.
J. Morinus Lucæ Holstenio antiqvam
amicitiam renovat.
Clarissimo & Eruditissimo D. Holstenio
Bibliot. Vatic. custodi Joann. Morinus
JAm longum tempus elapsum est, cla-
rissime Holsteni, cùm literis tecum
non egi; non ideo tamen existimo mei
oblivionem te cepisse, nam non modo
tanta cum amicitiæ & familiaritatis de-
monstratione me Romæ viventem com-
plexus es, verum etiam anteqvam Romā
accederem, me æstimatione & laude tua
ita commendabilem reddidisti, ut mei
memoriam in animo tuo nunqvam abo-
leri posse confidam; his ergo fretus anti-
qvam amicitiam nostrā hac Epistola re-
novaturus nihil tibi injucundum aut im-
portunum me facturum spero. Vive igi-
tur felix mei nonnunqvam memor, ami-
citiæ & obseqvii mei securus; nihil tibi
tam honorificum & eminens continge-
re potest, qvod votis non præcipiam
& præoptem. Parisiis xvij. Kal. Nov. An. MDCLIV.

page.notes: The date line reads "clɔIɔ CLIV." in the scan, rendered as MDCLIV (the reversed-C numerals cIↄ = M, Iↄ = D). The "J" of "JAm" is a drop cap, kept as printed. The catchword "EPIST." sits alone at the bottom right. Left-edge scan marks and the faint bottom mark are not printed text and are omitted.
